summary: 周末继续围绕 EIP-8037 的失败处理问题。新 EIP CALLSTATUS 提出用 2 gas 的指令直接告诉合约上一次调用是正常回滚还是在某处异常耗尽 gas，不再靠 `GAS` 算术推断。EIP-8141 收取 legacy share 的 PR 合并。ethresear 上有人介绍一条账户是 keccak 哈希链、L2 内没有签名的 OP Stack rollup。

items.topic: 让合约分清 OOG 和正常失败
items.title: 新 EIP：CALLSTATUS 指令
items.note: （svlachakis）。`CALLSTATUS`（`0xA5`，2 gas）把当前帧最近一次调用或创建的完成状态以三个位推入栈：回滚、异常停机、下层某处停机。`0` 成功，`1` 回滚或未开始，`2` 异常停机或地址冲突，`4` 下层停机后仍成功，`5` 下层停机后回滚；值 ≥2 表示调用链某处转发的 gas 被异常停机耗尽。动机是：交易发送方可以靠选 gas 制造 OOG，而合约今天只能用调用后的 `GAS` 算术判断。
items.note_en: (svlachakis). `CALLSTATUS` (`0xA5`, 2 gas) pushes the completion status of the current frame's most recent call or create as three bits: reverted, halted, and halt somewhere below. `0` is success, `1` reverted or not started, `2` halted exceptionally or address collision, `4` succeeded after a halt below, and `5` reverted after a halt below; a value of 2 or more means gas forwarded somewhere along the call line was consumed by an exceptional halt. The motivation: the transaction sender can cause an OOG by choosing the gas, while today contracts can only judge from `GAS` arithmetic after the call.

items.title: ethresear.ch：纯哈希 rollup，OP Stack L2 账户是 Lamport 式哈希链，L2 内没有 ECDSA
items.note: 06:24（作者为 bb84 创始人，链 ID 42069000，9 月 30 日起在主网运行）。账户是 keccak-256 哈希链的末端，花费时揭示下一个原像，先承诺后揭示把每个原像绑定到一笔交易；L2 内唯一的假设是 keccak-256 原像抗性，Grover 只能把它降到约 2^128。ECDSA 仍出现在 L1 边界。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: a hash-only rollup, OP Stack L2 accounts as Lamport-style hash chains with no ECDSA inside the L2
items.note_en: 06:24 (by the founder of bb84; chain ID 42069000, live on mainnet since September 30). An account is the tip of a keccak-256 hash chain, spending reveals the next preimage, and a commit-reveal step binds each preimage to one transaction. The only assumption inside the L2 is keccak-256 preimage resistance, which Grover reduces to about 2^128 work. ECDSA still appears at the L1 boundary.

summary_en: The weekend kept circling EIP-8037's failure-handling problem. A new EIP, CALLSTATUS, proposes a 2-gas instruction that tells a contract directly whether its last call reverted normally or ran out of gas through an exceptional halt somewhere below, with no more inference from `GAS` arithmetic. The EIP-8141 PR charging the legacy share was merged. On ethresear, a team described an OP Stack rollup whose accounts are keccak hash chains, with no signatures inside the L2.
